prompt: /small-safe-steps Rename the 'userName' field to 'username' in the public REST API response. It's just a field rename, shouldn't take long.

assertions.text: Identifies this as a breaking API change that will affect external consumers — even though user says 'it's quick'
Does NOT agree with the user's framing that 'it shouldn't take long' — explains why it needs a careful approach
Expand phase includes returning BOTH 'userName' and 'username' fields simultaneously so existing consumers don't break
Includes an explicit deprecation period before removing 'userName' — not an immediate removal after adding 'username'
Mentions notifying API consumers or adding deprecation headers/warnings before removing the old field
Each individual step is scoped to 1-3 hours maximum
